description: The remaining _NON_ARTICLE_TYPES from shared/utils.py: registry work types that are affirmatively not studies. EXCLUDE-ONLY, never require — `type` coverage is incomplete and inconsistent across CrossRef and OpenAlex, so an allow-list of good types would silently drop real replications. "other" is deliberately absent (the registries' catch-all, including ordinary articles), as are "data-paper" and "software-paper", which are papers ABOUT data. `dataset` has its own rule.

measured.rationale: A hand-check of 50 provisionally-linked rows found 23 that were not studies — Dataverse/Zenodo/Mendeley deposits and eLife 'Author response' objects — every one of them carrying a giveaway type.
